summary: 100% tuition fee reimbursement and monthly maintenance allowance for post-secondary and college students.

steps.title: College admission verification
steps.description: Secure admission in recognized college, university, or polytechnic institution.

steps.title: Submit application on National Scholarship Portal
steps.description: Register using OTR (One Time Registration) via Aadhaar Face RD app.

steps.title: Upload scholarship documents
steps.description: Upload caste certificate, parent income certificate (under ₹2.5 Lakh), and previous class marksheet.

steps.title: College level verification (Level 1)
steps.description: College scholarship nodal officer inspects attendance and verifies course fee structure online.

steps.title: District social welfare officer approval (Level 2)
steps.description: State department approves scholarship and releases DBT payments directly to student account and college.
